brand.descriptor_zh: 百年京张城市 AI 生长系统
brand.descriptor_en: Centennial Jing-Zhang Urban AI Growth System

concept.summary_zh: 标志将京张铁路的连续性、小月河和遗址公园的生长曲线、三个 AI 责任节点收束为开放生长回路，表达需求汇集、协同研发、公共实证、分类转化和反哺的连续关系。
concept.summary_en: The mark condenses the continuity of the Jing-Zhang Railway, the Xiaoyue River and heritage-park growth curve, and three AI responsibility nodes into an open growth loop for problem intake, collaborative research, public validation, conversion, and return.
concept.boundary: The mark is not a map, statutory boundary, real railway alignment, approved project, government emblem, or implementation commitment.

prohibited_uses: Do not stretch or compress the logo non-proportionally.
Do not rotate, skew, or change the direction of the open endpoint.
Do not change the relative position of the three nodes and collaborative spine.
Do not recolour, add gradients, strokes, shadows, glow, or 3D effects.
Do not place on low-contrast or visually noisy backgrounds.
Do not disassemble and rearrange the primary name, English name, or descriptor.
Do not force unreadable descriptor text below the minimum size.
Do not present the mark as a legal redline, real route, completed project, government identity, or approved engineering work.
